fact: A USAID-funded FAO and NASA Harvest project launched in 2021 combines mobile-collected field data with satellite images; Malawi's Ministry of Agriculture carried out an assessment of 2,095 fields in 11 southern districts after Cyclone Freddy (March-April 2023) using these tools, and early yield forecasts for 2023/2024 were planned for the Ministry.
title: From the soil to the stars
